The distraction-free writing experience is a game-changer, and the editor’s sleek design, inspired by Notion and Medium, makes content creation feel effortless. The fact that it integrates with any framework and gets you up and running in no time is just icing on the cake. Raymond here, and I'm stoked to introduce you to Wisp - the CMS that's about to make your adding a blog to your website a whole lot easier! That's when Wisp was born - a lightweight, delightful CMS that empowers you to focus on what really matters: connecting with your audience. 🚀 Set up in less than a day | Integrate with any framework 📝 Distraction-free writing | First-class editorial experience 🔧 All batteries included | Pagination, tagging, related articles out of the box 🌐 Global content delivery | Lightning-fast edge API and CDN Ready to experience the magic? Try out the drag-and-drop image upload, play with our powerful slash commands, and see how effortless content creation can be: 👉  Get started with a template! 🗞 If you would like to get started with a brand new blog, check out this minimalist blog template in Nextjs 14. You can get hook up wisp, host your site on vercel and have a live blog in 20 min or less! I just want to get the annoying things out of the way so that they can focus on what's the most important things for them. The fast setup, seamless integration, and distraction-free writing experience are exactly what creators need to focus on connecting with their audience without tech headaches. I love how you've made it lightweight yet packed with essential features like pagination and global content delivery.
